title: Runpod Background Removal (rembg)
description: Serverless background removal powered by rembg. Provide image URLs or base64; returns a cut-out RGBA PNG, optional alpha mask, composited image on a custom background, and the foreground bounding box. Supports U2Net, IS-Net, SAM, and BiRefNet model families.

input.name: Default model
input.description: Default rembg model used when 'model' is not given in the request. One of: u2net, u2netp, u2net_human_seg, u2net_cloth_seg, silueta, isnet-general-use, isnet-anime, sam, birefnet-general, birefnet-portrait.
